title: MV Press Turn Battle System integration with Yanfly's Element Core

posts.author: DragonMedic
posts.body:
Hello,
So for the first plugin (Press Turn System), it works mostly as it would in Shin Megami Tensei games. Unfortunately, there's a missing function because of the default system of RPG Maker itself: elements of any kind cannot be reflected or absorbed, only resisted, nullified, or made a weakness. Yanfly's Element Core allows for elements to be reflected or absorbed.
I would like to request that someone to make code in the Press Turn System to allow for the situation when an attack is reflected or absorbed, that it would remove all turns from the attacking side.
Press Turn Battle (PTB) Battle System Plugin for RPG Maker MV by Next Level Gaming
a-higher-plane.itch.io
Element Core (YEP) - Yanfly.moe Wiki
www.yanfly.moe
I do realize that both are paid plugins, and I will be willing to make this a classified post if no one happens to have already purchased both.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Just to mention it, the Element Core is not a paid plugin, it's a part of Yanfly's free bundle.
What have you already tried? I obviously don't have that rather expensive version of a plugin I already wrote, but the reflect element is using the same part of the code as the regular magic reflect trait. So if the author supported reflect ending the turn, that should still work whether it's a regular reflection or from an element.
I know that doesn't help with the null and absorb, but it's at least a part of what you're asking.
Edit: Also, the Element Core's null is not a defensive feature. It prevents
attackers
from getting elements applied to their actions. So I don't think it would really make sense for that to end the turn because...it would always end the turn every time that actor attacked.

posts.author: DragonMedic
posts.body:
The only other Pass Turn system plugin I've found is this one, and it has most of what your plugin has, it just differs that the paid one has the function of letting an actor use a skill or item, but staying on that actor.
Also, when I said null, I should have used "Void" instead, that's what SMT calls an attack that an enemy or character is immune to.

Oh - that has nothing to do with the element core, then. Battlers can have a 0% element rate and take 0 damage from attacks in regular MV.
Again, I'm not familiar with the paid plugin you have, but in mine that would be pretty easy to do. You'd use a Yanfly's Skill Core post-damage notetag and the script calls I included in my documentation to consume the rest of the turns if inflicted damage was 0. Perhaps you can do something similar in this plugin.
Anyhow, I just wanted to make sure that what you were asking for is clear. Perhaps someone who's purchased the plugin you're using and also knows how to code will help you out.
